Working rules:
- Prefer wiki pages for meaning.
- Prefer standard-named source copies over inbound originals.
- Preserve source fidelity.
- Do not rewrite source content when linking or extracting semantics.
- Treat published_external essays as public external artifacts, not inbound files.
- Search indexes public navigation metadata, not raw file contents by default.
